title: Quality_Ledger event line
description: One append-only ledger line: exactly one of mechanical_check, director_judgment, agent_self_correction or director_edit. Unsigned numbers and enums are pinned so a dashboard column never changes type between lines.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with a timezone (written as UTC); validate rejects garbage or a time with no timezone

workflow_id.description: kind of pipeline, e.g. neon_parcel_longform, etsy_listing

attempt.description: goes up when the output is regenerated (or Tony edits it), not per check; checks on the same artifact_sha256 share one attempt

source.description: director_edit = Tony edited/fixed the asset himself; actor must be Tony, reason (what he changed) required, no check or director object

actor.description: script name, harness name, or Tony (always Tony for director_judgment and director_edit)

reason.description: may be empty for a mechanical pass or a director_judgment (an empty reason on a mechanical fail/error is a warning); required non-empty for agent_self_correction and director_edit

failure_type.description: optional, fixed list (never free text): what kind of thing went wrong; omit the key when nothing failed

measured.description: the deciding value; finite number or null only (no NaN/Infinity)

threshold.description: finite number or null only (no NaN/Infinity)

artifact_path.description: the generated file a check measured, or Tony's edited file (as given on the command line)

artifact_sha256.description: sha256 of that file's bytes; mechanical checks with the same fingerprint as an event on the step's latest attempt share that attempt (a regenerated file is a new attempt)
